scientific_requirements: Score only independent final scientific conclusions, with fixed pass/fail weights totaling 100. Actual linked calculations or reproducible data analysis must support each claim with correct chemical identity, physical definition, conditions and reference. Numbers, structures, modes and state assignments are evidence, not author-value acceptance windows or separate process scores. A supplied observation, guessed answer, software execution or copied source value alone earns no credit. A fully supported equivalent explanation or an explicitly permitted evidence-based model-sensitive conclusion passes directly; missing or insufficient evidence and unsupported contradictions fail the affected item. There is no need_review state. One failed item does not erase independent supported points. Whole-case success is assessed separately from the numerical score. AR chooses a justified method; PR assesses the disclosed baseline or substantiates a physically comparable substitution and its consequences. Historical reference defects remain recorded and do not automatically confer success.

rules.expected: Actual transition-orbital, density or equivalent evidence assigns dye1 low-energy absorption to the conjugated molecular pi electronic system, identifying participating imine/aromatic/organoboron framework rather than asserting causality from a near wavelength alone. An unchanged connectivity file or orbital-gap number alone is insufficient.

rules.expected: Conclude that the chemically mapped methoxy substitution changes the electronic transition distribution on the intact framework and accounts for the dye2 versus dye1 long-band blue ordering. Link actual state-character evidence with comparative energies and supplied spectra, rather than claiming that every electron donor necessarily red-shifts every band. Include both disclosed gas-phase S1 energies and oscillator strengths from actual calculations in the comparison: the baseline has a higher-energy, stronger low transition for dye2 than dye1. Explain how this electronic/intensity response relates to the substitution and keep gas roots distinct from solution maxima. All four values are supporting evidence, without separate magnitude targets.
